text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Come in. The door is open, Nakayama-sa—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh. ...My, please excuse me. It was 
you, was it?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: So, what can I do for you today?

text_block_list.name: News Article
text_block_list.text:
"【Fan Voting: Orfevre Takes 1st Place】 
Fan voting for the Arima Kinen concluded 
today, with Orfevre securing the top 
spot."

text_block_list.name: News Article
text_block_list.text:
"【Arima Kinen: Orfevre Withdraws】 After 
leading the fan vote by over 25,000 votes 
ahead of 2nd place, Orfevre announces her 
withdrawal from the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: News Article
text_block_list.text:
"【Orfevre to Challenge the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe Again Next Year】 Having 
announced her withdrawal from the Arima 
Kinen, Orfevre revealed her plans for the 
coming year――"

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...So Orfe is skipping the Arima Kinen, 
huh. Well, she's had one intense race 
after another since the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe's Japan Cup was so exciting too, 
wasn't it~! She must've been exhausted 
from the overseas trip... but she was so 
strong~."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
No matter what losses there were, Orfevre 
was number one in the Arima fan vote! —In 
other words, that's all that matters!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a shame about skipping the 
Arima Kinen, but... It sounds like Orfevre 
will be running next year, too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Or so they saaay~? So you'll run for 
Golshi-chan's sake, right~♪

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall not.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~!?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre. Preparations for your 
departure are complete."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "CASE: Investigation Headquarters"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Flash! Isn't the press conference for the 
Arima Kinen today? Do you really have time 
to be slacking off?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true, but... I haven't seen 
Golshi-san or the others since this 
morning...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Golshi-san? I'm holding onto a note 
from her~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Try and find me," she said.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Ama & Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Gold Ship is skipping today's press 
conference!? She's the favorite to win the 
Arima Kinen, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"According to the host, there's a video 
message for us! Let's see what it is—"

text_block_list.name: Video Message
text_block_list.text:
"Lush green grass, waves seep through—the 
God Road."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That's not an excuse at all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the hallway, I looked into the 
chaotic venue. The staff seemed to be in 
quite a bind.
choice_data_list:
...Looks like a job for an ally of 
justice.

...Looks like a job for an ally of 
justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I knew they were up to something, and 
as expected, they're right here.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go. Boss. Could you make 
the arrangements?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Aaaah~... The sound of the waves 
is soothing my very souuul~...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aaah...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: âSECURED!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Target secured! Boss, contact the 
helicopter pilot! Get ready for departure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle rattle rattle rattle...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Huh, what? Mame-chin!?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Freeze! I foresaw that you would come to 
this deserted island!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You just got jealous of all the hype 
around the Japan Cup, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yet when I boldly stepped into the Arima 
Kinen myself, everyone's eyes were solely 
on Orfe-san, who wasn't even running!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You felt it was boring if it couldn't top 
that day—you were sulking!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~!? Golshi-chan isn't pouting at 
all—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That's not all—you tested me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"If it were you, you could've done 
something hilarious at the press 
conference and caught at least one 
person's interest. And yet—...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what a child! Teasing people! 
Causing trouble for others!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—You act recklessly like that because you 
expect someone to find you right away.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Even though you're the one who caught me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Don't act so mighty. I'm the one getting 
the short end of the stick here. I'm the 
one who should be angry.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to you, I find myself strangely 
well-trained as well..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you escape, Golshi-san. I 
really need you to pull your weight.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gotta crank up the difficulty next time.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...If you believe you can break free, by 
all means, please give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm escorting you to the press conference. 
If we take a helicopter, we can still make 
it in time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Putting Fenomeno and the others on the 
helicopter we had on standby, we hurried 
back to the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to coordinating with the staff in 
advance, I managed to slide into the press 
conference room right after—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —I'll do my best at the Arima Kinen~♪

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Since you kept me waiting, give me an 
answer that's actually newsworthy!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Ahahaha! To think this duo would 
keep making me laugh all the way to the 
end of the year~

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Fenomeno...! Hold Gold Ship 
by the scruff of her neck and don't let 
go...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Give it up, Golshi-san.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Aren't I entertaining when I'm with you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...! Ha, hahaha! Why, you...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Don't get thrown off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship takes 1st place in the Arima 
Kinen! What a spectacular way to wrap up 
the year!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Golshi-chan ain't done yet, not 
by a long shot!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Beyond Japan, beyond the entire world. I'm 
gonna pull off the most fun thing in the 
universe!! So, you see—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Follow my lead! You too! Not above, not 
below! Our generation is definitely gonna 
be the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Fight properly next time, Mame-chin.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The green planet is at its most beautiful 
when viewed from the cosmos.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "...You really are... doing that again..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"R-R-RUNNER C-COURSE D-DEVIATION O-OFFENSE 
C-COMMITTED, S-SIRRR! ! ! !"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Gold Ship-san!? Oh no, someone catch 
her! We still have plans after this—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —This officer will go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Fenomeno chases after Gold Ship. 
Anywhere, and always.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wait, Gold Ship!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I will only say this once. Listen 
carefully.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for always taking care of me.
